pattern: いずれにしても / いずれにしろ / いずれにせよ
aliases: izure ni shitemo / izure ni shiro / izure ni seyo
purpose: Keep a conclusion in place whichever possibility is true.
keywords: いずれにしても / いずれにしろ / いずれにせよ + conclusion
Whether by train or bus, we need to change.
Either way, we cannot decide today.
Success is uncertain, but it is worth trying either way.
formation: いずれにしても / いずれにしろ / いずれにせよ + conclusion
mistake: It does not decide which alternative is correct.
